hash: sha256 of float32 voxel values, per scan, after nibabel as_closest_canonical

meaning.train: used to train the models: scores will look better than real-world performance
meaning.val: used to pick the best checkpoint during training: scores will look somewhat better than real-world performance
meaning.test: held out: none of the models saw it during training, so this is a fair check
meaning.unlabelled: from the dataset's unlabelled part: never used by the models, but there is no expert outline to compare with
